spendDataCoresOn: Spend data cores on permanent upgrades for your pilot. Pick a node of the tree to see its ranks, costs and requirements; Basic research opens Advanced and then Elite tiers, and some skills grant a mastery perk at max rank.
dataCoresDropFrom: Data cores drop from aliens and mission rewards. You can reset research at any time.
collectRiftFragmentsTo: Collect rift fragments to open a rift: a wave-based instance with its own lives and big rewards. Each tier is harder and pays more.
spendRiftKeysOr: Spend rift keys or Aether to enter an open rift. Fragments come from aliens across the galaxy.
aFormationMakesYour: A formation makes your drones fly in a pattern and grants passive bonuses: more damage, tougher shields or speed, each with a trade-off. A formation only works while you have enough drones fitted, and each one has its own level requirement.
buyFormationsHereWith: Buy formations here with credits or Aether, then pick the active one from the Drones tab of Equipment. Escort is free and always available.
foundAClanOr: Found a clan or accept an invite. Members share a tag and a bank, filled by a small tax on earnings, that pays for clan-only rifts.
toJoinAnExisting: To join an existing clan, ask an officer for an invite: it appears in this window.
yourLasersAndShield: Your lasers and shield generators can be made stronger with credits. Open the Upgrade tab to see how.
eachLevelAdds2: Each level adds 2% of the module’s base value: damage for a laser, capacity for a shield generator, up to +30% at level 15. The first levels are cheap, the last ones are long-term goals. Pay with credits at the base or on a safe gate; the tab shows a green number when a fitted module can be upgraded right now.
theUpgradeBelongsTo: The upgrade belongs to the module: it moves with it between ships, but it does not carry over to a new module and it is lost if the module breaks. Keep upgraded gear repaired.
yourLevelRankAnd: Your level, rank and experience. Levels unlock new screens; rank grows with the points you earn.
yourWalletCreditsCr: Your wallet: credits (CR) for gear, Aether (AE) for premium items, data cores for Research.
yourCompanySetsYour: Your company sets your home sector. You can change it from the Pilot screen while the playtest lasts.
missionsPayFarMore: Missions pay far more than free hunting: credits, XP and Aether. Open Available and accept one; you can keep up to 5 active.
dailyAndWeeklyMissions: Daily and Weekly missions refresh on their own; Milestones reward long-term goals.
progressIsTrackedOn: Progress is tracked on screen while you fly.
aTimelineOfWhat: A timeline of what happened to your ship: rewards, purchases, repairs and refusals.
checkItWhenSomething: Check it when something did not go as expected.
loadoutTheCentreShows: Loadout: the centre shows your slots, the right side your inventory. Click an item to fit it, click a fitted one to take it off.
rightClickAnItemPress: Right-click an item (press and hold on touch) to repair or sell it. Equipment only changes in a safe zone.
dronesAddSlotsUpgrade: Drones add slots, Upgrade makes lasers and shields stronger.
oreFromDestroyedAliens: Ore from destroyed aliens goes into your cargo. Refine it into better materials here.
boostAppliesAMaterial: Boost applies a material to a weapon or shield for a temporary bonus.
aFullCargoHold: A full cargo hold stops you collecting more: refine, apply or dump ore.
pickACategoryOn: Pick a category on the left, then open an item to see its stats and price.
setTheQuantityAnd: Set the quantity and press Buy. New gear goes to your inventory: fit it in Equipment, inside a safe zone.
ammoRocketsShipsAnd: Ammo, rockets, ships and drones are sold here too.
rareGearAndShips: Rare gear and ships go up for auction. Each house has its own lots and timer.
openAHouseAnd: Open a house and bid in credits; the lots where you lead are highlighted.
keepAnEyeOn: Keep an eye on the clock: a house closes when its timer runs out.
everySectorAndThe: Every sector and the gates between them. Farther sectors have stronger aliens and better rewards.
clickASectorThen: Click a sector, then press Set route: the minimap and a marker in space show the next gate.
flyOntoTheGate: Fly onto the gate and press J to jump.
spendDataCoresOn2: Spend data cores on permanent upgrades for your pilot.
pickANodeTo: Pick a node to see its ranks, costs and requirements: Basic research opens the Advanced and Elite tiers.
youCanResetYour: You can reset your research at any time.
aRiftIsA: A rift is a wave-based instance with its own lives and big rewards.
collectRiftFragmentsFrom: Collect rift fragments from aliens to open one; each tier is harder and pays more.
enteringCostsARift: Entering costs a rift key or Aether.
foundAClanOr2: Found a clan or accept an invite. Members share a tag and a bank.
theBankIsFilled: The bank is filled by a small tax on earnings and pays for clan-only rifts.
toJoinAClan: To join a clan, ask an officer for an invite.
shareYourCodeOr: Share your code or link. A friend who enters it gets a big welcome pack.
youArePaidAs: You are paid as they play: at each level they reach, and at every rank of the recruiter ladder.
pressClaimToCollect: Press Claim to collect everything that is ready.
rankingsOfPilotsAnd: Rankings of pilots and clans: experience, kills and honor.
switchBoardWithThe: Switch board with the chips at the top; your own position is shown at the bottom.
droneFormationsAreNow: Drone formations are now for sale. Open the Shop, then click the highlighted Formations tab.
yourNewSectionIs: Your new section is ready. Click the highlighted button to open it.
thisSlotHoldsYour: This slot holds your ship's exclusive ability, shown with its own icon. Click it, press its slot number or press X to fire it.
itWorksOnceThen: It works once, then recharges: the seconds left count down on the slot, and it flashes when ready.
hoverTheSlotTo: Hover the slot to read what your ability does. Every ship has a different one.
